title: Knock down two AprilTags with the ball (VEX AIM, 18 in field)
description: Grab the ball, knock down one AprilTag sign with it, grab the ball again and knock down the second, in 60 s. 1 point per sign knocked down by the ball. Arena: the 18 x 18 in (0.457 m) VEX AIM field, 4 tiles. Layout 'photo' reproduces a team's start photo. MotionBench-defined, not an official VEX game.
